newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: ACCESS trading system back to normal after glitch.
newsitem.headline: ACCESS trading system back to normal after glitch.

text.p: ACCESS, an after-hours system for trading New York Mercantile Exchange (NYMEX) futures contracts, was halted for over an hour on Friday by a communications failure, system operators in New York said.
However, ACCESS officials said by telephone the system was now operating normally.
They said it was halted between 1921 and 2035 New York time (2321-0035 GMT).
ACCESS allows electronic trading of NYMEX open-outcry contracts, covering various energy and commodities contracts.
